title: What happens when someone places an order

steps.note: The server mounts the order routes under /api. [src/server.ts:7] A POST to /api/orders answers 201 with the new order. [src/routes/orders.ts:10-12]
placeOrder first checks that every product exists. [src/services/orders.ts:14-15]
The order and its items are written in one create call. [src/services/orders.ts:16-21]
